name: Thea
self_text: I’m a Nigerian man in my early 20s, always on PC. Lately I’m all about Skyforge Arena, playing casual matches and chatting over voice. I usually have time on Sundays, either in the morning or afternoon. I also enjoy learning to sail in my spare time.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Skyforge Arena, you must be available either Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning, I’d strongly prefer that you enjoy casual matches though it’s not a requirement, and it would matter a lot if we overlap on voice chat, but I won’t rule you out over it.
